text: Then and Now (Japanese: , Kako to Ima) is an Affinity Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received in the BLADE Barracks in New Los Angeles.

Thug Mephites (Japanese: , Sagu Mepitesu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Mephite family, and can be found at level 31-40 at the Secluded Lava Lake in Sylvalum, which can be found in a cave right next to the FN Site 401.
Thornboxes (Japanese: , Hana no Konabako) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia.

The Trading Floor (Japanese: , Jōnō, Payment to the Government) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Mumun, who can be found in the Dorian Caravan, in the middle of Oblivia's Lake Basel.

Thulium Petramands (Japanese: , Tsuriumu Aranea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Petramand family and can be found at level 11-12 on the wedge-shaped land projection south of FN Site 501 in Cauldros. Four must be defeated for Arms Testers Wanted.

The Pip-Squeak (Japanese: , Mewomiharu Gijutsu, Amazing Technology) is a Normal Mission in . It is a request from Matthew in the Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District. Aganeba creates the Aganeba Alloy during the course of the mission, that must be delivered to Matthew. It is one of three options for completing Proficiency Exam 8, but can be completed before receiving that mission.

The Mad Monk (Japanese: , Avaranchi no Hakaisō, Avalanche's Sinful Monk) is an Affinity Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be accepted near the exit from East Gate in the Administrative District.

The Dadaan Girls (Japanese: , Dadān Gāruzu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 60 at Scabland Fortress in Oblivia after completing Chapter 12. They are members of the group that fights alongside Dadaan, the Strongest Prone.
Thermal Shield is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Shield Trooper at rank 2.
Theroid Slayer is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Samurai Gunner at rank 9.

The Line of Fire (Japanese: , Jiyū Ishi, Free Will) is a Normal Mission in . It is a request from Alice in the Residential District. She can be found talking with Eliza under one of the second to most northeast trees on Deliverance Park. The Basic Mission Escort Requested can be used to locate this mission.

The King of Fear (Japanese: , Kyōfu no Bōgyaku-ō, Tyrant King of Fear) is an Affinity Mission in . It can be accepted near the Cathedral in the Residential District and the primary destination is Noctilum.
The Stick is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Dorian Caravan and the primary destination is Oblivia. It is a request to gather two Auravis Croaking bags.

The Voltant Visionary (Japanese: , Zarubogga no Seishitsu, The Nature of Zarubogga) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Trachlo Lythren in Central Industrial District of New Los Angeles. Although it is not required, the Basic Mission Buddies on the Brink can be used to locate this mission but it is available later after completing both Dead Men Tell No Tales and A Dubious Operation. .

The Good Thief (Japanese: , Borutanto no Yukue, Where the Voltant Is) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Horonalderon in the Industrial District near Repenta Diner.
The Root of All Evil (Japanese: , Gōyoku, Avarice) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Tobias outside the BLADE Barracks in the Administrative District.

The Handy Ma-non (Japanese: , Ma Non no Shūriya, The Ma-non Repairman) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Sostenasa in the Administrative District Hangar of New Los Angeles. It is one of three options for completing Proficiency Exam 8, but can be completed before receiving that mission.

The Journey Begins (Japanese: , Uchi ni Himeru Ishiki, The Conciousness Hidden Inside) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be accepted from Kun'luarb in the Residential District of New Los Angeles. Although it's not required the Basic Mission Departure's Eve can be used to locate this mission.

The Fashionista (Japanese: , Mienai Oshare, Unseen Fashion) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received by Victoria on Central Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.

The Techie is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located by the West Gate in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles, beside shipping containers at the bottom of the stairs, between Elma and Cross in the afternoon.

The Membership (Japanese: , Kagayakeru Hakugakudō Goannai, Invitation to the Shining Temple of Learning) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from May May and the primary destination is the Ma-non Ship. This mission marks the beginning of Cross' bronze membership of the Miranium exchange financial group Shimmer & Savvy. Although it is not required, the Basic Mission Miranium for Fun and Profit can be used to locate this mission.

The Popular Girl is Lin's third Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It occurs between Lin and Cross in the afternoon, on the Prospectors balcony on Division Drive, in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. Lin is surrounded by three female BLADEs who are fawning over her.

The Ol’ Fishing Hole is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located at the lower level of New Los Angeles, northwest of Deliverance Park in the Residential District down by the water, between Phog and Cross in the afternoon.

The Flower Child is Hope's first Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It occurs between Hope and Cross in the afternoon, in the round flower garden southeast of the Cathedral, in the Residential District of New Los Angeles.
The Jewelmonger is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Omari and the primary destination is Sylvalum.

The Search for Kun'luarb is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Kon'luarb and the primary destination is the Residential District of New Los Angeles. Although not required to accept it, this mission leads into the Normal Mission Circle of Life.
The Ladies' Man is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located south of East Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles between Yelv and Cross at any time.

Thick Cinicula Horns are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from the horns of Ciniculas. Five are required for the related mission Partners in Prototyping. They are components in all Ultrafauna Criticals Up and CriticalUp.ULTRAFAUNA augments.
The Fan Club is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is on the Starboard side of the Ma-non Ship between Lao and Cross at any time.

The Winds of Change is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located north east of the BLADE Tower entrance in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles (overlooking the Commercial District), between Lao and Cross at any time.

Thea Falsaxum, née Thea Pilattis, is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Tree Clan Prone. She is first encountered in the Port Side of the Ma-non Ship under her original name. After A Grim Undertaking she changes her name to Thea Falsaxum and can be found dancing at night in front of the Industrial District's Repenta Diner.

The Savage Protector is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.13, and is unlocked if the Auravises were defeated during Fish in Troubled Waters. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
The Queen Is Dead (Japanese: , Onteki, Sworn Enemy) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Ni Zinga in the Wrothian Stronghold in Oblivia.
The Ostrich's Obsession is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located at the Hangar in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles, between Frye and Cross at night.

The Little Rich Girl (Japanese: , Watashi kore demo――, Even still, I――) is an Affinity Mission in . It can be received at the north end of Division Drive in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.

The Bodyguard (Japanese: , Nopon no Yōjinbō) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be accepted from Zazazan near the Emerian Battlegrounds in Cauldros, next to the cliffs west-northwest of FN Site 505.
The Big Bang (Japanese: , Potepote no Yōkyū, Popote's Request) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Popote at the Drongo Caravan in Cauldros.

The Art of War (Japanese: , Yurusarenu Kizuna, Unforgivable Bond) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Sajif Scoppio at the Starboard of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles. The mission also involves Vio Penga who disagrees with Sajif's battle plan.

The Bug Whisperer (Japanese: , Orufe no Mushidzukai, Orphean Bug Repellant) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Min'barac in Ishmael Hills in the Residential District of New Los Angeles. Although not required, the Basic Mission In Support of Science can be used to locate this mission.

The Ultimate Price (Japanese: , Daishō, Compensation) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Quincy beside the elevator to the Administrative District of New Los Angeles, east of the Cathedral.

The Divine Nopopon (Japanese: , Seirei Nopopon, English dub: ) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Shinshin in the Residential District of New Los Angeles. The Legendary Nopopopopon is offered by Nopopon upon completion of the mission.
The Party Line (Japanese: , Daihyō Senshutsu, Representative Elections) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Sun'barac at the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.

The Sword of Legendaryness (Japanese: , Hakken!? Densetsu no Tsurugi, Discovery!? The Legendary Sword) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Muimui in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.
The Old Gods (Japanese: , Zarubogga no Kamigami, The Zaruboggan Gods) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Feloran at the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.

The Unbreakable Sword (Japanese: , Kongōfue no Katana, The Adamantine Blade) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from De Zing in the Ma-non Ship of New Los Angeles. This mission is unusual in that the outcome depends on a choice made after the final objective. If the player chooses to accept the Unbreakable Sword, De Zing returns to the Ma-non Ship and dreams of creating an unbreakable sword large enough to be wielded by Skells; if the player refuses, De Zing keeps the sword and remains at Cauldros's Adder Byroad to train.
The Duel (Part I) (Japanese: , Saikyō no Otoko Sono Ichi, The Strongest Man, Part the First) is a Normal Mission in . It can be received from Gi Zang at the Ruins on the Sandbank in Oblivia.

The Lurker (Japanese: , Tenkamusō no Akkan, The Unequalled Scoundrel) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Go Rogan on the Deck of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.

The Gauntlet (Japanese: , Rāsu Budō Taikai, The Wrothian Martial Tournament) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Zo Ozuchi at the Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles. After the fourth battle against Gwin, HT665: Erio reveals her true identity immediately upon defeat, having disguised herself as Gwin.
Thinning the Thalluses is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Alex and the primary destination is Noctilum.
The Next Big Thing is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from an apparel maker and the primary destination is Cauldros.

The Rescue Request is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Sevvy Belgazus and the primary destination is the Ma-non Ship. Although not required to accept it, this mission leads into the Normal Mission Tree-mendous.
This Is My Rifle is Irina's third Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It occurs in the morning in the Administrative District's Hangar.

The Call to Counterattack is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from HT665: Erio and the primary destination is the Industrial District of New Los Angeles. It leads into Good Fortun, but is not a prerequisite of that mission.
The Care Package is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Dodonga Caravan and the primary destination is Noctilum.
The Carrot is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Dorian Caravan and the primary destination is Oblivia.
The Emerian Battlegrounds is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a historian to find the Emerian relic.
The Endless Ring is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Nopon Commerce Guild and the primary destination is Oblivia.
The Fearsome Placid Duoguill is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Pathfinders and the primary destination is Primordia.

The Final Faceoff is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from HT665: Erio and the primary destination is the Commercial District in New Los Angeles. It leads into Definian Downfall.
The Herbalist is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a Tree Clan Prone and the primary destination is Oblivia.
The Phantasmagoric Fan is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Dopang Caravan and the primary destination is Sylvalum.
The Poshest Produce is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a Restaurant Owner and the primary destination is Sylvalum.

The Scars of War is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Hala Gorida and the primary destination is the Port Side of the Ma-non Ship. Although not required to accept it, this mission leads into the Normal Mission A Grim Undertaking.
The Scrubdown is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a male mechanic and the primary destination is Oblivia.
The Skell Spectrum is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a male mechanic and the primary destination is Cauldros.
The Taste of Tersqual is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request to gather a Tersqual Eel Kebab for a restaurant owner.
The Ultimate Pursuit is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from an Orphean and the primary destination is Oblivia.
The Voltant Void is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a Zaruboggan to obtain Belzadozebu Scallions in Cauldros.
Thick-Skinned is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a mechanic to obtain Hard Skins.
The Divine Napopon is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is received from Nopopon in the Whale's Nostril in Noctilum, after defeating the Nopopon Incarnate during The Divine Nopopon.
The Divine Nipopon is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is received from Nopopon in the Whale's Nostril in Noctilum, after defeating the Nopopon Incarnate during The Divine Nopopon.
The Divine Nupopon is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is received from Nopopon in the Whale's Nostril in Noctilum, after defeating the Nopopon Incarnate during The Divine Nopopon.

The Gold Membership (Japanese: , Kagayakeru Hakugakudō Kaiin Gentei, Exclusively for Members of the Shining Temple of Learning ) is a Normal Mission in . It can be received from May May at the Starboard of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles. Completing it unlocks the Basic Mission Miranium Exchange (75K credits).

The Platinum Membership (Japanese: , Kagayakeru Hakugakudō Daishukketsu, The Great Sale of the Shining Temple of Learning) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received by talking to May May on the starboard side of the Ma-non Ship.

The Silver Membership (Japanese: , Kagayakeru Hakugakudō Goyūtai, Hospitality of the Shining Temple of Learning) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received by talking to May May on the starboard side of the Ma-non Ship. Completing it unlocks the Basic Mission Miranium Exchange (50K credits).
The Manservant is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located anytime near Deliverance Park in the Residential District of New Los Angeles between Murderess and Cross.

The Choice is Nagi's first Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It occurs during the afternoon on the south side of the ECP building, which is west of the Administrative District's Mimeosome Maintenance Center in New Los Angeles.
The Get-Together is Nagi's fifth Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It takes place in the afternoon in a backyard on the south side of the Residential District's Ishmael Hills.

The Client is Mia's first Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It occurs during late night in the Residential District's Ishmael Hills, in the alley between the houses south of the Water Purification Plant.

Thick Coronid Hides are prime materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Coronids. They are components in X, XV, and XX Resist Topple and Resist.TOPPLE augments. One is needed for Bottomless Baggage.
Thick Millesaur Hides are prime materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Millesaurs.
Thick Falsaxum Horns are rare materials in . They can be obtained from Falsaxum.
The Superior Form is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts H.B. posing shirtless. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Attack on Biahno Hills.

The Blood Lobster is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a red-clothed helmeted man holding a Stuffed Lobster and being surrounded by them. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Rise of the Blood Lobster.
The Indigen Whisperer is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Min'barac riding a blatta. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission The Bug Whisperer.

Thudclang Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Nopon Commerce Guild Shield. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Sparking a Smile. The Thudclang weapons available in-game are: * Archetype Thudclang * Iron Thudclang * Carbide Thudclang * Cermet Thudclang * Chrome Thudclang * Chromoly Thudclang * Cobalt Thudclang * Original Thudclang * Titanium Thudclang * Ceramic Thudclang * Diamond Thudclang

The Final Menace is a Global Nemesis mission in . It is a mission to defeat Yggralith Zero, and can be received from the Squad Missions menu at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. The mission is unlocked when the Conquest Progress meter on the Squad Select screen is full, and remains available for around 3 or 5 days, 7 days initially, or until Yggralith Zero has been defeated. To accept the mission, the player must use a BLADE Medal. The battle takes place atop the Kw'arah Villa in Cauldros. Yggralith Zero may summon one or two large level 50 Filiavents during the battle.

The Docile Ovis is a Support Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked when Chapter 12 is completed, and is intended to make it easier to level up characters by earning EXP, Class EXP, and Battle Points. Enemies do not drop any items in this mission. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

The Grand Plot is a Support Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked when Chapter 12 is completed, and is intended to make it easier to level up characters by earning EXP, Class EXP, and Battle Points. Enemies do not drop any items in this mission. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

The Rising Beasts is a Support Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked when Chapter 12 is completed, and allows a large amount of Credits and Miranium to be earned quickly. Enemies do not drop any items in this mission. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

The Unearthed Xe-dom is a Support Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked when Chapter 12 is completed. It allows the player to quickly raise affinity with party members, and earn Division Points to raise one's BLADE Level. Enemies do not drop any items in this mission. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

The Infernal Beast is a Time Attack Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked after Chapter 6 is completed, and features a level 30 version of the Tainted Sphinx boss. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

The Wrothian Samurai is a Time Attack Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked after Chapter 9 is completed, and features level 40 versions of the bosses Vasara and Deva Caladar. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

The Expert Warrior is a Time Attack Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked after Chapter 11 is completed, and features a level 50 version of the Prog Ares boss. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Theroids (Japanese: , Bīsuto, Beast) are a category of enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It includes all beast-like and bird-like enemies. Theroid enemies have the widest distribution across the five regions of Mira, alongside Insectoids, and contain the highest number of species, at thirty one types. Regular Theroids also share a common primary weakness to Thermal attacks, and a secondary weakness to Ether based attacks, with airborne Theroids also being weak to Gravity attacks, and no resistances, with Tyrants usually having 5 extra resistance against every attribute.
Thermal Res Up is a ground armor attribute resistance Augment in and that increases thermal attribute resistance. The Skell equivalent is SpecUp.THERM-RES.
Thermal Attack Plus is a ground weapon attack Augment in and that increases the damage dealt by all thermal-attribute weapons and Arts. The Skell equivalent is AttributeDmg.THERM.
Theroid Criticals Up is a ground weapon critical Augment in and that increases critical chance when attacking Theroid-classified enemies. The Skell equivalent is CriticalUp.THEROID.

The Third Barrier Key is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It must be obtained during Definian Downfall along with the First Barrier Key and the Second Barrier Key to lower a forcefield. It can be found in Cauldros's Ganglion Antropolis, on the eastern ledge of the southeast room.
Thermal Res Down is a stat debuff in . Thermal Res Down increases the damage taken from thermal-attribute attacks.
The Three Swords constitute an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are obtained from Zo Langra during A Dish Served Cold.

The Thermal Exhaust Fork (Japanese: , Netsugen Haishutsu-kan - Bunkiro) is a Location in . It is located on the Lower Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain. It is connected to the Old Plumbing Entrance, and it can be found by following the path in the old plumbing.
The Theosoir Main Gate (Japanese: , Teosuaure Seimon) is a Landmark in . It is located in the Kingdom of Tantal, serving as the entrance into Theosoir.

The Three-Vein Crossroads (Japanese: , Akasuji no Sansaro) are a landmark in . They are located on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal. It is the junction of three different paths: to the south the Little Banerro Ruins, to the north the Sacred Ice Caverns, and to the east Theosoir via the Capital Approach. The Heart-to-Heart "Curse of the Zekenator" can be viewed here.

The Theosoir Rear Gate (Japanese: , Teosuaure Uramon) is a landmark in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, to the north of Amphoret Pillar. It serves as the rear entrance into Theosoir. There are no enemies here.
Theoscaldia Palace (Japanese: , Ōkyū Teosukarudia) is a level in . It is located in the Kingdom of Tantal, in Theosoir. There are no enemies here except during the story event.
The Millenarian Titan are Literature Pouch items in . They can be purchased at the Reedirait Bookstore in the Argentum Trade Guild and at Colpon Books in the Indoline Praetorium.
The Girl on the Hills are Art Pouch items in . They can be purchased at Cmalaf Artwork run by Peline in Torigoth in the Gormott Province and at Jugos Antiques in the Indoline Praetorium.
